hip_frame.how: printed PA6-CF web-down (turned 45 deg on the bed), 100 % solid; 20 x M4 into the motors, 2 x 61812 pressed in from the motor side onto a 2 mm lip (no retainers), 6 x M5 inserts in the flange ends, 4 x Ø16 stop pins in blind holes (23 deep, retaining compound)

upper_link.how: printed PA6-CF flat, 30 mm, 100 % solid; 8 x M5 into the adapter; the knee shoulder screw clamped by an M10 nyloc in a pocket; a radial stop face each side of the hub

front_link.how: printed PA6-CF flat on its inner face, 20 mm body; two 6201-2RS at the knee, two 61812 at the apex (pressed against a central web)

wheel_link.how: printed PA6-CF flat on its outer face, 26 mm body; two 6201-2RS at the knee; the BotWheel in its outer face (4 x M6 from inside the hub), the hub for the apex 61812 (DIN 471-60 circlip)

apex_spacer.how: printed PA6-CF ring between the apex 61812s' inner races

stop_sleeve.how: printed TPU 95A cap-down, 100 % solid; a stretch fit on the stop pins

note: hours are rough: grams / material density / a strength-holding volumetric rate
